headlines.text: It was 2023 when KUSHIDA announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance against Darby Allin, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.59 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle. The NJPW junior heavyweight legend made his AEW debut challenging Allin for the TNT Title, testing the champion in a rare junior-style clash before Allin retained.

2025 brought us this moment: Adam Page vs. Christopher Daniels fought it out in a Texas Death match, getting things started right out of the gate on Collision, rated 8.30 ? a real highlight of the night in a hard-fought men's division clash, part of the special Maximum Carnage '25 - Night 2 card.

Flash back to 2025, when Kazuchika Okada vs. Tomohiro Ishii clashed for the AEW Continental Title, appearing on Collision, rated 6.08. Kazuchika Okada was chasing gold for the 10th time. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.

secondaries.text: On a Wednesday in 2023, back when it marked the first-ever meeting between Bryan Danielson and Bandido on Dynamite, rated 8.77 ? a match fans still talk about.
On this day in 2025, Undisputed Kingdom (Cole, O'Reilly & Strong) stepped through the curtain for the first time as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 5.30.
Turning the clock back to 2023: the AEW All-Atlantic Title was up for grabs as Orange Cassidy vs. Jay Lethal went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.82.
